verdict.rationale: Gemini's first-party help docs say Gemini Apps can generate and refine images with Nano Banana 2. They also document local edits to parts of an image, character consistency across generations, blending of multiple images, and 2K downloads. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of generation and editing quality, and an explicit statement that edits are driven by natural-language prompts (implied rather than stated).

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can generate and edit images from natural-language prompts

citations.quote: Gemini Apps can help you generate and refine images to help bring your imagination to life.
Local edits: Making quick and specific changes to parts of an image.
Character consistency: Maintain the look of a person or character across various generated images, including the ability to combine multiple images to blend scenes or ideas.
Download images at at 2K resolution with a Google AI plan or at 1K without an AI plan.
